_doc: ledger 0079 round Q item 1 (Kevin 2026-11-03: "I just want real"): Quebec's edges by tools/lidar_curb_trace.py (a continuous lidar curb-line trace along the road, checked against NAIP 2023 in the track frame), and 48th's two legs at Quebec by the same tool (one carriageway each). Per record: the midline every row_m (merge_forks' stations between the two OSM carriageways), its normals (+ = toward piece B), OSM's ribbon offsets, each traced line's lateral per row, its step (m, + = the line's own sense; outer lines |step|), `curb` / `naip` / `ok` per row as '0'/'1' strings, `kind` per row for the outer lines (c = curb: rises outward, d = drop), the kept segments, and `apply`: what a re-centre would take (both edges of a carriageway ok, bridged, tapered). NOT wired into the build (round Q: see the ledger). Lidar: CO_DRCOG_2_2020 class 2 (the scratch tile cache of tools/lidar_connector_profile.py; nothing fetched); connectors: the build's pre-trim pieces (rp1).
